reported_observations.soda_service: The new prototype is connected and serving soda.
reported_observations.next_milestone: Resolve the fit issues and button up this working level of prototype.

quotes: I do have a new prototype technically connected up and serving soda, but due to a number of fit issues I had not identified soon enough, it is a bit of a hack.
I still think getting this level of prototype tight and buttoned up will be a good next milestone, but we do have progress here and I am pleased with that.

photographs.availability: Retained privately; no photographs or private attachment references are included in the repository.
visible_observations: The prototype is arranged on the countertop beside the kitchen sink.
A white faucet stands on a separate countertop support with its small display illuminated.
The black fluted printed enclosure carries a display in its sloped face.
Two exposed pump heads and looping external tubes are visible above the enclosure.
One photograph shows a glass containing yellow-green liquid beside the prototype.
photographs.scope: The photographs document the visible assembly state. Soda service is established by Derek's report; the photographs do not independently establish dispensing or fluid routing.

article_identity.scope: The report and photographs do not bind the installed parts to exact design or print revisions. The photographed faucet is not identified as the October 17 localized-cooling and raised-display replacement.

qualification_limits: The report establishes soda service without identifying the working flavor or confirming both flavors.
The actual fluid routing, reservoir operation and installed firmware are unspecified.
Installed Prime, Fill, Clean and Dry operation and complete cutover acceptance are not separately recorded here.
The setup is on the countertop; final under-sink installation, intended shell closure and complete assembly fit are not established.
The revised C14 access bore, enlarged passive tube passages and raised-display faucet geometry retain their separate physical-fit evidence limits.
This observation does not establish leakage or pressure performance, safety qualification, load capacity or endurance.
The report does not enumerate the fit workarounds. The linked part observations retain their own article identities and acceptance scopes.

related_records.scope: Reported fit of the listed October 7 prints; excludes the back top and completed wet-prototype acceptance.
October 17 C14 access, Mean Well wire-space and blind tube-insertion observations; revised geometry has separate physical-fit limits.
Normal assembly accepted for the identified fan-off cover; other faucet parts fractured during installation and the raised-display revision has no acceptance in that record.
Same-day report that flavor B's line carried flavor A's valve and flavor A's valve was fitted backwards; all issues reported resolved.
